x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

def gcdLL(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

min_num, min_den = 100000, 1
best_a, best_b = 0, 1

def check_ratio(x, y, b, a):
    global min_num, min_den, best_a, best_b
    if a < 0:
        return
    divisor = gcdLL(a, b)
    a //= divisor
    b //= divisor
    numerator = abs(b * x - a * y)
    denominator = b * y
    g = gcdLL(numerator, denominator)
    numerator //= g
    denominator //= g
    if numerator * min_den < min_num * denominator:
        min_num = numerator
        min_den = denominator
        best_a = a
        best_b = b
        return
    if numerator * min_den == denominator * min_num:
        if b < best_b:
            best_a = a
            best_b = b
            return
        if b > best_b:
            return
        if a < best_a:
            best_a = a
            best_b = b
            return

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    check_ratio(x, y, i, (i * x) // y)
    check_ratio(x, y, i, (i * x) // y + 1)
    check_ratio(x, y, i, (i * x) // y - 1)

print(f"{best_a}/{best_b}")
